programme.title: Seljaci, serija
programme.desc: Serija "Seljaci" je saga o nekoliko seoskih porodica koje žive u našem selu Treskavica, a čiji su mnogi članovi rasuti po svetu od Pariza do Novog Zelanda. Dolazi do mešanja starih i novih običaja i navika, što je izvor mnogih konfliktnih i komičnih situacija. Zašto gledaoci vole da gledaju seriju "Seljaci"? Zato što je autentična, naša, što sa blagom ironijom i humorom govori o našim manama i lošim navikama, a sa velikom simpatijom o našim tradicionalnim vrednostima...

programme.title: Ljubav navika panika, serija
programme.desc: Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rešavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno...oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije...oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu... oni su srećni u svađama, neverovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje... kada ljubav postane navika da li sve postaje panika.....

programme.title: Neki bolji ljudi, serija
programme.desc: Neki bolji ljudi porodična je serija čije glavne junake predstavljaju članovi porodice Urošević i Graovac. Dramsku radnju pokreću događaji koji protagoniste dovode u situacije kroz koje će se ispoljiti njihovi lični interesi i ambicije, prožeti jakim međusobnim emocijama. Tri generacije pod jednim krovom, u komšijskim stanovima Graovac i Urošević, predstavljaju idealan teren za sukobe generacija i sistema vrednosti ali i fini humor. Đuro i njegova žena Jovanka pripadaju posleratnoj, bejbi bum generaciji koja se školovala, radila i vaspitala decu u socijalističkom duhu. Dragan i Marija su predstavnici generacije X koja je najbolje godine svog života potrošila tokom devedesetih godina 20 veka prošlog veka. I dok je Marija uspela da se visoko pozicionira u poslovnoj hijerarhiji, Dragan je prihvatio ulogu domaćice u kući. Nikola, Sara i Filip su deca novog milenijuma, generacija kojoj je život na mreži podjednako važan kao i realnost. Ipak, kad ih sustignu iskonski porivi, kao što je ljubav, biće prinuđeni da se okrenu sebi i suoče sa osećanjima. Tada polako počinju shvatati da se u virtuelnom svetu ne možeš sakriti od stvarnosti. Porodica Graovac - Urošević je pod konstantnim pritiskom s kojim se mosi kako zna i ume, a prilično često niti zna, niti ume. Decu pritiskaju izazovi i iskušenja odrastanja, očekivanja roditelja i sami roditelji; roditelje pritiskaju bračni problemi i deca, a babu i dedu - porodični i egzistencijalni problemi. Kako će se naši junaci sa njima nositi i da li će posle svega postati neki bolji ljudi, ostaje da se vidi.

programme.title: Sutjeska, film
programme.desc: Teritorij Bosne i Hercegovine, 1943. godine. Nakon što se obznanilo da njemačke trupe pristižu u Jugoslaviju, na pomolu je velika bitka koja bi mogla odnijeti mnogo žrtava. Partizanski vođa Tito (R. Burton) svjestan je opasnosti u kojoj se nalaze on i njegovi ljudi: njih dvadeset tisuća, zajedno sa središnjom bolnicom, opkoljeni su u bosanskim vrletima. Uslijedit će teške borbe, tijekom jednog proboja i Tito će biti ranjen, a mnogo će hrabrih ljudi poginuti... Film "Sutjeska" Stipe Delića, uz "Bitku na Neretvi" Veljka Bulajića, najpoznatiji je jugoslavenski cjelovečernji film NOB-u. Rekonstrukcija je to jedne od najmučnijih vojnih operacija koje su se dogodile na teritoriju bivše Jugoslavije, u kojoj je poginulo s obje strane više od sedam tisuća boraca (među poginulima je bio i opjevani narodni heroj, Titov pouzdanik, Sava Kovačević). Atraktivno je režiran, prepun spektakularnih i napetih ratnih prizora, ali se podjednako usredotočuje na psihološke dileme vrhovnog zapovjednika, kao i na potresne sudbine pojedinaca. Unatoč nekim nedostacima koje mu je predbacivala kritika (stereotipni likovi boraca i patetika), publika je dobro prihvatila film (čime su pridonijeli i slavni glumci, prvenstveno R. Burton) te ga je ovjenčala nagradom Jelen na Pulskom festivalu 1973. Film je osvojio i Zlatne arene za najbolji film, scenarij i najboljeg glumca (Lj. Samardžić), te brončanu za režiju. Film je snimljen 1973.

programme.title: Dom za vešanje, film
programme.desc: Perhan (Davor Dujmović) romski je adolescent koji svojim umom može micati predmete. Kriminalac Ahmed uvjeri ga da napusti svoju požrtvovnu baku (Ljubica Adžović) i ljubljenu djevojku da bi svojim sposobnostima ilegalno zaradio novac. Dok postaje muškarac i uči zanat kriminala, mladić traži svoju sestru (koja je trebala ići na operaciju noge) i pokušava uštedjeti novac da bi ostvario svoj san i vratio se doma te se oženio ženom svojih snova. Emir Kusturica je ovim filmom 1989. godine osvojio nagradu za režiju na filmskom festivalu u Cannesu. Bio je to ujedno prvi film čiji su dijalozi u cijelosti snimani na romskom jeziku.

Sama zarađuje za izdržavanje porodice, trudi se da bude dobra majka, ocu svoje dece prijateljica, da i domaćem ljubimcu, ogromnom psu, pruži toplinu doma. U toj trci ona zaboravlja da je žena i to privlačna. Jedno letovanje uneće mnoge novine u život ove porodice od četiri žene i jednog psa

programme.title: Plavuša s Harvarda 2, film
programme.desc: Elle Woods (R. Witherspoon) je u žaru priprema svog vjenčanja. Udaje se za svog nekadašnjeg profesora s Harvarda, mladog i zgodnog Emmetta Richmonda (L. Wilson). Da bi sve bilo savršeno, do dana vjenčanja želi pronaći prave roditelje svog psića Bruisera. Privatni istražitelj otkrije da je Bruiserova mama u Bostonu, no ne živi u nekoj otmjenoj obitelji, kao što je Elle pomislila, nego u kozmetičkom laboratoriju u kojemu se rade pokusi na životnjama. Iako se nada da će u odvjetničkom uredu u kojemu radi kao pripravnica dobiti podršku u borbi za oslobađanja Bruiserova mame, Elle umjesto toga dobije otkaz. Puna energije kao i uvijek ne očajava. Ako se ne može boriti protiv pokusa na životinjama, može se boriti za zakon koji će to zabraniti. Puna poleta kreće u Washington u svoju do sada najneizvjesniju pravničku bitku, ali i ovaj put na svoj jedinstveni način. Put do kongresmenskih srca bit će složen i maštovit, pomoći će njezino bratstvo Delta Nu, ali i tek otkrivena homoseksualna orijentacija njezinoga voljenoga Bruisera... Podsjetimo da je lik lijepe studentice prava i kasnije mlade pravnice, koja je dotadašnji život proživjela kao razmažena, neambiciozna bogatašica s Beverly Hillsa, stvorila Amanda Brown, autorica romana "Legally Blonde". Iako su mnogi bili razočarani ovim nastavkom, film je bio veliki hit, a osvojio je i nagradu Genesis kao najbolji film. Nekoliko nagrada i nominacija donijeli su mu glazba, kostimi, stilisti i, dakako, šarmantna Reese Witherspoon, upravo savršena glumica za lik Elle Woods.

programme.title: Rampage: Totalni kaos, film
programme.desc: Primatolog Davis Okoye (Dwayne Johnson), čovjek koji drži ljude na distanci, neraskidivo je povezan s Georgeom, iznimno inteligentnim i nevjerojatno rijetkim albino srebrnim gorilom o kojem se brinuo otkad ga je kao mlado siroče spasio od lovokradica. Ali kad tajni genetski eksperiment pođe po zlu, ovaj nježni primat mutira u bijesno stvorenje goleme veličine. Što je još gore, ubrzo se otkrije da postoje i druge takve životinje. Dok ti novostvoreni alfa-grabežljivci jure Sjevernom Amerikom uništavajući sve što im je na putu, Okoye se udruži s diskreditiranom genetičarkom Kate Caldwell (Naomie Harris) u svrhu pronalaska protuotrova probijajući se kroz vječno promjenjivo bojište, ne samo kako bi bi zaustavio globalnu katastrofu nego i da spasi strašno stvorenje koje mu je nekad bilo prijatelj.

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum sa teritorije cele Srbije, svih starosnih i socijalnih kategorija svoj dan počinje uz "Novo jutro". Pored najpopularnijih voditeljskih tandema, gledaoci tokom cele radnje nedelje ostaju uz naše jutro zahvaljujući pravovremenom i aktuelnom izveštavanju kroz neizostavne rubrike: "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "(Ne)zapaženo" i mnoge druge. Zaštitni znak "Novog jutra" su i uključenja iz cele Srbije, ali i Beograda zahvaljujući autentičnom Filipu Maksimoviću i uvek nasmejanom Milanu Raoniću, uz koje ćemo i ovu sezonu početi u vrhu top liste gledanosti.

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: „Novo vikend jutro na Pinku u novoj televizijskoj sezoni vodi Jovana Jeremić. Svake subote i nedelje od 05:30 do 13:00 časova, Jovana će obrađivati sve aktuelne teme iz zemlje i sveta sa stručnim sagovornicima i napraviće retrospektivu svih najvažnijih događaja koji su obeležili prethodnu nedelju. U okviru "Novog vikend jutra", gledaoci će se upoznati sa novim rubrikama: "Press pretres" koji podrazumeva prelistavanje dnevne štampe uz osvrt na one teme o kojima se najviše pričalo; "Pravo metu" kroz koju će Jovana obrađivati temu jutra; "Verovali ili ne, i ovo postoji" je rubrika rezervisana za one teme i događaje koji su začudili i iznenadili javnost; u okviru rubrike "TV duel" Jovana će ugostiti dve suprotstavljene strane koje će imati priliku da iskažu svoje mišljenje o datoj temi; i "Vikend retrovizor" koji predstavlja rekapitulaciju svega što je obeležilo prethodnu nedelju.

programme.title: PREMIJERA: vikend specijal
programme.desc: Za "Premijeru vikend specijal" govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde, a čine je i aktuelne vesti iz sveta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije svake nedelje priprema televizijski maraton i retrospektivu prethodne nedelje, uz sve važne vesti iz života poznatih i aktulenosti iz Srbije i regiona. Osim novog studija i dobro poznatih rubrika - "Pričalo se o...", "Dogodilo se", "Premotavanje", "Sa lica mesta", "Beograd noću", "Dan za nama", "Njihovih 1800 sekundi sa Nemanjom", "Nedeljno popodne sa..." i "Muzički kutak" - sedma sezona "Premijera - Vikend specijala" doneće i potpuno nove rubrike u svakoj emisiji.

programme.desc: Za razliku od većine sličnih formata, ekipa emisije Ekskluzivno ima drugačiji pristup poznatim ličnostima. Direktno i bez uvijanja, sva ona pitanja koja drugi ne smeju da pitaju, postavljaju novinari emisije Ekskluzivno i donose priče o poznatima iz drugog ugla.

programme.title: Dani od snova, film
programme.desc: U ambijentu užarenih prostranih polja, mlada djevojka provodi ljetnji raspust čuvajući stado ovaca. Čini se da je nemoguće da bilo šta promijeni usporeni ritam svakodnevice i njene osame. S obližnjeg aerodroma avioni prelijeću polje na kome djevojka čuva ovce. Jedan od njih se izdvaja. Pilot tog aviona i djevojka započinju pravu mladalačku i spontanu igru. Mjesto gdje je djevojka pronašla svoj mir ubrzo postaje mjesto traganja za potpunom ljubavlju. Ali, možda je sve to samo san...

programme.title: Kafanica blizu SIS-a, serija
programme.desc: Već znamo da je "Agencija za sve i svašta" vlasotinačko preduzeće koje rešava sve probleme svojih klijenata. Osnivač i vlasnik firme je Spiridon Don Karamarković, nekadašnji pripadnik Legije stranaca, ekspert za sva pitanja i najškrtiji gazda na svetu. Deda mu je rekao da svaki uspešan Srbin mora da ima kafanu i on je ove godine osnovao svoju. Poslove oko kafane poverio je misterioznoj Madam Žaklini koja je naše gore list, ali je ugostiteljsko znanje sticala u Parizu.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup, 2018 - Sprint 2 World Cup Duisburg
programme.desc: Welcome to Duisburg in Germany! The World Cup 2 of the 2018 season is being disputed, and athletes from all over the world are pitching themselves in one of the most beautiful settings we have on the circuit. Kayaks, canoes, singles, doubles and fours... all are fighting to go to the Olympic Games in Tokyo in two years time. Let's see where they are at the moment! Discover the best action of the weekend's regatta in Duisburg.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup, 2018 - Sprint 3 World Cup Montemor
programme.desc: In this third stage of the competition we are in Montemor-o-Velho, in Portugal. This is the 2018 ICF Sprint World Championships, where 676 athletes from 66 nations are ready to give everything they have and raise with the title. The weather is perfect and the organization is perfect. Will the athletes be up to standards in this awaited event? Let's look back at the best of the action over the past four days of competition.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: After making their debut in indomitable style in 2014, the unique flying catamarans literally "took off" on their first European Circuit in 2015. Building on the success of the America's Cup foiling catamarans, the GC32 takes the thrill of foiling to an extraordinary performance level in a fiercely fought five stage circuit raced across five iconic venues in Italy, Spain and France.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez
programme.desc: 2019 - - Meeting and Sailing at Les Voiles De St Tropez Marking the end of the Mediterranean yachting season, Les Voiles de Saint Tropez will be back for its 20th edition. Close to 4,000 sailors and more than 300 sailing yachts will gather in St Tropez in early autumn for an action-packed programme of competitive racing and lively social events.

programme.title: Perilous Sea
programme.desc: Perilous Sea is a transcontinental cold-water surfing odyssey capturing the raw spirit, glorious landscapes and pure perfection that arises when conditions align. This incredible story creates moments of cold-water nirvana that rival any across the globe. Inspired by the storytelling style of classic ocean-fairing novels, Perilous Sea follows a group of surfers as they explore the landscapes and waves of the North Atlantic fringes. From the Canadian Maritimes, north to Iceland and beyond to the wave rich coast of Ireland, this award-winning film takes us on a journey to the world of surf. Follow them into the water as they dare to get into the treacherous waters that have taken the lives of many in Perilous Sea: a story of overcoming challenges and spirituality.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: 2022 - : Biograd, Sukošan, Bibinje, Ugljan, Pašman, Dugi Otok Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: In this episode of Sail-Ho Croatia we are continuing our adventure journeying through beautiful islands of the Zadar archipelago. We will first stop in Biograd, the host of the largest Boat Show in this part of Europe. After that, we’ll visit the stunning islands of Olib, Silba and Premuda and head over to Ugljan and Pašman. Stay with us!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The story of Split has been going on for 17 centuries, ever since the Roman emperor Diocletian decided to build a palace on this peninsula. Today, it offers tourists with an attractive and rich tradition, magnificent history, cultural heritage and beautiful nature. This is why Split is considered an unmissable destination in the Adriatic. Stay tuned in our new episode of Sail-Ho!

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Kite Masters is a series showcasing the latest news from the inspirational world of kite boarding - the action packed sport which continues to take the world by storm. Whether you are a kiteboarder - competitor or recreational, kiteboarding fan, interested observer or have ever wanted to give kiteboarding a go, then you are guaranteed to enjoy the Kite Masters series. programme.title: Rolex New York Yacht Invitational Cup, 2023 - Highlight
The South To Sian Journals
programme.desc: While filming South To Sian, a pair of adventurers dived into what began as a three-month trip and turned into a two-year odyssey of exploration.On boards, bikes, by boat and four-wheel drive, Harrison Roach and Zye Norris discovered if, in these days of GPS and WiFi, the dream of a true pioneering surf adventure is still alive.South to Sian Journals is a collection of stories documenting the people, places & adventures that occurred during the 2 years making South To Sian - the challenges, the surfers, riders, shapers, bike builders, filmmakers and photographers.Extremely entertaining and insightful, Journals documents the travels, the hardships, the spectacular locations, the personalities and the thoughts of the characters, both in front of and behind the lens.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup, 2018 - Sprint 2 World Cup Duisburg
programme.desc: Welcome to Duisburg in Germany! The World Cup 2 of the 2018 season is being disputed, and athletes from all over the world are pitching themselves in one of the most beautiful settings we have on the circuit. Kayaks, canoes, singles, doubles and fours... all are fighting to go to the Olympic Games in Tokyo in two years time. Let's see where they are at the moment! Discover the best action of the weekend's regatta in Duisburg.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup, 2018 - Sprint 3 World Cup Montemor
programme.desc: In this third stage of the competition we are in Montemor-o-Velho, in Portugal. This is the 2018 ICF Sprint World Championships, where 676 athletes from 66 nations are ready to give everything they have and raise with the title. The weather is perfect and the organization is perfect. Will the athletes be up to standards in this awaited event? Let's look back at the best of the action over the past four days of competition.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: 2022 - : Biograd, Sukošan, Bibinje, Ugljan, Pašman, Dugi Otok Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Perilous Sea
programme.desc: Perilous Sea is a transcontinental cold-water surfing odyssey capturing the raw spirit, glorious landscapes and pure perfection that arises when conditions align. This incredible story creates moments of cold-water nirvana that rival any across the globe. Inspired by the storytelling style of classic ocean-fairing novels, Perilous Sea follows a group of surfers as they explore the landscapes and waves of the North Atlantic fringes. From the Canadian Maritimes, north to Iceland and beyond to the wave rich coast of Ireland, this award-winning film takes us on a journey to the world of surf. Follow them into the water as they dare to get into the treacherous waters that have taken the lives of many in Perilous Sea: a story of overcoming challenges and spirituality.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: After making their debut in indomitable style in 2014, the unique flying catamarans literally "took off" on their first European Circuit in 2015. Building on the success of the America's Cup foiling catamarans, the GC32 takes the thrill of foiling to an extraordinary performance level in a fiercely fought five stage circuit raced across five iconic venues in Italy, Spain and France.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez
programme.desc: 2019 - - Meeting and Sailing at Les Voiles De St Tropez Marking the end of the Mediterranean yachting season, Les Voiles de Saint Tropez will be back for its 20th edition. Close to 4,000 sailors and more than 300 sailing yachts will gather in St Tropez in early autumn for an action-packed programme of competitive racing and lively social events.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: 2025 - GP of Italy (Ski GP & Ski Ladies GP) After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: In this episode of Sail-Ho Croatia we are continuing our adventure journeying through beautiful islands of the Zadar archipelago. We will first stop in Biograd, the host of the largest Boat Show in this part of Europe. After that, we’ll visit the stunning islands of Olib, Silba and Premuda and head over to Ugljan and Pašman. Stay with us!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The story of Split has been going on for 17 centuries, ever since the Roman emperor Diocletian decided to build a palace on this peninsula. Today, it offers tourists with an attractive and rich tradition, magnificent history, cultural heritage and beautiful nature. This is why Split is considered an unmissable destination in the Adriatic. Stay tuned in our new episode of Sail-Ho!

Wind Masters
programme.desc: 2022 - : Zadar, Nin, Iž, Olib, Silba, Premuda, Molat, Pag Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. programme.title: Ciuri Ciuri
programme.desc: Sicily, the largest Mediterranean island and just off the toe of Italy’s boot is the destination chosen this time by our Nautical Hosts Andi and Chelsey as they head to the South of Italy to meet up with renowned Sicilian sailors. Its rich history is not only reflected in their cuisine and culture, but also on their sailing techniques that balance tradition with modern skills. They will discover the coastlines near Palermo to learn how to tack and jibe and of course will try the delicious Sicilian cuisine. Join Andi and Chelsey on their journey around Sicily learning about sailing and tasting traditional dishes in Ciuri Ciuri, exclusive on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts
programme.desc: Arguably, a superyacht is the most glamorous holiday you can take. Burgess yachts, the largest yacht broker in the world, talks to us about the process of owning and/or chartering your very own yacht.We take a look at just how yachts are marketed and meet with Australian Shipbuilders Silver Yachts, who achieved the amazing feat of getting a Mercedes car onto their Yacht Silver Fast for one of the most epic yachts commercials ever.For those wanting more than a charter, but don’t want to own a boat outright, we introduce them to MAHA Yachts, a brand new concept bridging the gap between Charter and Sales - a unique collaboration with the world leading hotelier Adrian Zecha from Aman Hotels and Feadship.We sign off with one last adventure underwater, exploring the sea with Deep Flight and Rainbow Fish, interviewing Dr. Xin Wu who is helping to pioneer deep water tourism.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts
programme.desc: In the latest episode of Inside Superyachts we interview Ken Freivokh, designer of some of the world’s most iconic yachts and concepts ever. Besides talking to the genius behind some of the best yacht masterpieces we meet with Thirty C leading CGI concept designers.Lastly, we know that no yacht would be complete without a vessel to get you to and from shore. Pascoe Tenders open their doors to us to have a look inside these space-aged, hyperluxurious tenders.

programme.title: Second Life In Scandinavia
programme.desc: Hello from Sweden! We are on our way to the island of Orust. This island lives from boatbuilding, and big companies produce sailing boats here to expand their boats to the entire world. When the economic crisis stroke, demand decreased, thus less boats were ordered. This forced habitants of the small island of Orust to find a new path. Refit has become the new trend in Second Life in Scandinavia. Giving a new life to beautiful yachts, not only the economy is changing, but the local community as well. Lucia will venture into the island of Orust to learn more about the way its population has adapted and how it has become the mecca of boatbuilding. Watch out now, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris, 2015 - 2015
programme.desc: Among the world's greatest boat shows, Salon Nautique in Paris is back! Join Nico Peduzzi at the prestigious Port de Versailles and discover this year's hottest innovations in sailing, motorboats, board sports, equipment, tourism and more.

programme.title: Jump On Board, 2013: Greece
programme.desc: Mia has left the girls behind and we are reaching the sad ending of our trip. The crew sail from Skiros to Lavrion before Abi and Zita say their goodbyes to Georgios. Then, we recollect the best moments we have experienced in the Greek Islands with our two winners.

programme.title: Nemirni, film
programme.desc: Dogodila se teška prometna nesreća. Policija saznaje da je nesreću izazvao vozač ukradenog Peugeota 334-72. U automobilu se nalaze četiri maloljetne osobe. Svjedoci tvrde da je za volanom bila djevojka. Uslijed potjere djevojka koja je bila za volanom napušta automobil i nestaje u noći. Odmah zatim automobil doživljava nesreću. Policija nalazi stradale u olupini, ali djevojke nema. I u Beogradu policija traga za nepoznatom djevojkom. Ona se uspijeva sakriti u kabini jedne hladnjače, predstavivši se vozaču kao šumareva kći, na šta joj on povjeruje. Tijekom vožnje on se zaljubljuje u nju. U motelu, policija saznaje da je djevojka otišla sa vozačem hladnjače, ali u trenutku kada patrola stigne hladnjaču djevojka neopaženo iščezne i pobjegne u šumu. Potjera se nastavlja...

programme.title: Ritam zločina, film
programme.desc: Kad na vrata njegove trošne kuće u zagrebačkom Trnju pokuca sredovječni Fabijan (Fabijan Šovagović), povučeni Ivica (Ivica Vidović) ga pristane primiti kao podstanara. Ivica je nastavnik povijesti i zemljopisa u jednoj osnovnoj školi, a Fabijan mu se predstavi kao umirovljeni geometar koji se iz hobija strastveno bavi statističkim proračunima. On pedantno bilježi svaki zločin na Trnju i u Zagrebu i tvrdi da je sposoban utvrditi ritam zločina te predvidjeti kad će se dogoditi i gdje. Ivica mu isprva ne vjeruje, no počne se predomišljati kad Fabijan ubrzo točno predvidi nekoliko zločina u susjedstvu. Dok Ivica polako obnavlja vezu s nekadašnjom djevojkom Zdenkom (Božidarka Frait), zabrinuti Fabijan počne tvrditi da je ritam zločina ozbiljno narušen i da će se u njihovom kvartu uskoro dogoditi ubojstvo.

programme.title: Ta divna splitska noć, film
programme.desc: U mračnim i pustim uličicama splitskog geta tijekom posljednja dva sata stare godine isprepleću se tri priče izdvojene od neobuzdanog novogodišnjeg slavlja. Tri različita ljubavna para koji se zatiču oko Peristila - sitni diler Nike i udovica Marija s djetetom, mlada narkomanka u krizi Maja i razočarani mornar Franky te zaljubljeni i naivni adolescenti Luka i Anđela - pokušavaju naći izlaz iz krajnosti u koje su gurnuti i koje nepovratno mijenjaju njihove živote...

programme.title: Devojački most, film
programme.desc: Mjesto razmjene njemačkih zarobljenika i partizana zarobljenih od strane Nijemaca je Devojački most. Sa položaja kreće kolona mladih boraca i devet zarobljenih Nijemaca. Put do mosta je za mlade partizane dvostruko iskušenje: borilačko, jer sa svih strana vrebaju opasnosti, i etičko, jer se moraju izlagati riziku zbog neprijatelja koji je bio krajnje nemilosrdan.

programme.title: Između dana i noći, film
programme.desc: Tri priče o ocu i sinu u tri razdoblja: kraj Drugog svjetskog rata, vrijeme pada Berlinskog zida i nakon raspada Jugoslavije. U svakoj od priča, otac i sin naći će se u ekstremnim situacijama, u kojima će početi preispitivati vlastitu egzistenciju. Odluke koje će morati donijeti zauvijek će im promijeniti živote.

programme.title: Između dana i noći, film
programme.desc: Tri priče o ocu i sinu u tri razdoblja: kraj Drugog svjetskog rata, vrijeme pada Berlinskog zida i nakon raspada Jugoslavije. programme.title: Ti imaš noć, film
programme.desc: Nakon gubitka posla hostese na brodu, Sanja se našla u situaciji da nema gde da ode sem svojoj kući. Vraćajući se svom malom priobalnom gradu u Crnoj Gori, otkriva da je brodogradilište palo u stečaj i da su mnogi ljudi ostali bez posla. Oluja uzima jedan život. Sanjin brat čeka noć u šumi, noć koja može promeniti sve.

programme.title: Maturanti ( Pazi šta radiš ), film
programme.desc: Posljednji školski dani jedne generacije maturanata. Grupa mladih susreće se sa životnom prekretnicom kada će se trebati pozdraviti s jednim važnim dijelom života, rastati se od prijatelja i suočiti se s neizvjesnošću, nadama i planovima… Vrijeme je to kad se rađaju žarke ljubavi „za cijeli život, roditelji nastoje djeci nametnuti vlastite planove i ambicije, dok profesori gube svoj autoritet… Komedija Milana Jelića nastala je 1984. godine i bavi se jednom maturalnom večeri kao središnjim mjestom svih smiješnih, ali i ozbiljnih, događaja u koje zapadaju slavljenici, roditelji i profesori. U glavnim ulogama pojavljuju se Milan Štrljić, Ljubiša Samardžić, Milena Zupančić i drugi… Režija: Milan Jelić Uloge: Dragomir Bojanić Gidra, Ljubiša Samardžić, Milan Štrljić, Milena Zupančić, Velimir Bata Živojinović

programme.title: Živeti kao sav normalan svet, film
programme.desc: Radoš dolazi iz provincije u Beograd da se upiše na odsjek za kompoziciju Glazbene akademije. Pun je ideja i želi da stvara muziku za "čovječanstvo". Lijepa kolegica ga opsjeda, a on se bezuspješno udvara drugoj. Stanuje u sobici u potkrovlju i u čestoj besparici stanarinu gazdarici plaća u naturi. U početku oduševljen, polako se razočarava sredinom i odnosom profesora prema glazbi. Javno iskazuje svoje mišljenje da je glazba koja se forsira na Akademiji za mrtvace. On želi pravu, novu, veliku muziku i malo ljubavi. Iznenadna posjeta djeda iz provincije budi njegovu apolitičnu svjest. I pošto borba na fakultetu ne pokazuje rezultate, razočaran, Radoš se vraća kući. Otac ga primorava na povratak, u borbu.

programme.title: Piknik u Topoli, film
programme.desc: Kraka je opet pobjegao od kuće. S Maksom luta gradom cijelu noć. U dragstoru sreću studenticu Olgu i Kraka joj u šali ponudi brak. Nekoliko dana kasnije njih dvoje se zaista vjenčaju. Nekolicina mladih odlazi na obližnji kanal da nekonvencionalno proslave vjenčanje, no pojavljuju se i dva pripita vršnjaka iz obližnjeg gradića koje pozovu da im se pridruže. Mladići odbijaju, a Aleksova djevojka shvaća da je namjeravaju silovati. Nastane tučnjava u kojoj mladoženja i njegovi prijatelji moraju spašavati živu glavu.

programme.desc: Nakon dvomjesečne kome agent agencije za sigurnost pokušava se vratiti normalnom životu.

programme.title: Ivkova slava, film
programme.desc: Gazda Ivko, njegova supruga i prijatelji Kalčo, Smuk i Kurjak slave Đurđevdan. Slavlje se po običaju rastegne duboko u noć, no ove godine, kada im se pridruži nepoznati mladić Svetislav,, društvo odluči produžiti svetkovinu na tri dana!

programme.title: Protiv Kinga, film
programme.desc: Djeca malog grada skupljaju novac za čamac, koji im neprestano oduzima nasilnik. Ne znajući kako da mu se odupru, u prispjelom bolesnom skitnici, nekadašnjem boksaču, vide junaka svojih snova kome pružaju utočište u nadi da će, oporavljen, izaći na dvoboj s nasilnikom. Konačno, skitnica će prihvatiti borbu sa fizički mnogo jačim protivnikom, svjestan da će tu bitku izgubiti, ali i da će dobiti nešto mnogo više - ljubav i povjerenje sina koji se nalazio među djecom.

jazzahead! 2024, Concert
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead! paid special attention to the jazz scene of the Netherlands and invited over forty jazz acts to perform over the course of three days. Among the bands presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2024 is Sultan Stevenson’s trio. Pianist Stevenson, a Londoner with Caribbean roots, graduated from Conservatory in 2023. He is a rapidly rising talent in the London jazz circuit, whose debut album 'Faithful One' won him the Parliamentary Jazz Award for the best newcomer. Described by The Telegraph as an incipient master, Sultan Stevenson (piano) appears at jazzahead! 2024 with Jacob Gryn (bass) and Joel Waters (drums).

programme.title: Jazzed Out Berlin, Urban
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’. In this episode, Berlin serves as a backdrop for sets by pianist Wolfert Brederode, guitarist Kurt Rosenwinkel, and Hyperactive Kid.

programme.title: Long Tall Dex: Dexter Gordon Live in '63 & '64, Jazz
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 & '64 features three concerts filmed in 1963 and 1964 in Holland, Switzerland and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Filmed while Dexter was living in Europe, these shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano) and jazz classics ‘Blues Walk’, ‘A Night In Tunisia’, ‘Body And Soul’ and others. One of the most influential saxophonists in jazz history (both John Coltrane and Sonny Rollins claim him as an influence), Dexter Gordon is captured in sharp form and style on this 70-minute tour de force.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018, Free
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry. Joost Lijbaart, known from bands by Yuri Honing, is one of the top artists of the Dutch jazz scene. Guitarist Bram Stadhouders is one of the most renowned musicians of improvisational music in Europe. Together, the three Dutch musicians have developed their own universal language within the genre. Their performance at Bimhuis showcases their unique intergenerational chemistry and hypnotizing sound. Bimhuis Amsterdam provides a platform for pioneering national and international musicians by hosting over 300 concerts a year.

programme.title: Richard Bona - Jazz à Vienne, Jazz
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was the wonderful Richard Bona. He conquered the world with his bass and voice a long time ago. Joined on stage by Mike Rodrigues on trumpet, Luisito and Robert Quinteros on percussions, Ozzy Melendez on trombone, and Osmandy Paredes on piano, Bona once again shows why audiences around the world fall for his music.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Jeroen van Vliet Moon Trio, Modern
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox. From young, local talents to top national and international artists, PARADOX Tilburg is the most intimate jazz club in the Netherlands, with a devoted audience from all across Europe. In the TV show PARADOX LIVE you get a taste of the greatest concerts and interviews with artists from all around the world. This episode of PARADOX LIVE presents the amazing Dutch pianist Jeroen van Vliet.

programme.title: Artvark Saxophone Quartet & Ntjam Rosie: Homelands, Fusion
programme.desc: Homelands is a collaboration between Artvark Saxophone Quartet and Cameroonian-Dutch singer Ntjam Rosie. The music is inspired by both traditional and modern music from Ntjam’s home country Cameroon, (Manu Dibango and Richard Bona) as well as by an Afro-European blend of soul, jazz, gospel and world music. Using unorthodox sounds as the basis of their compositions, Artvark continues to be radical, experimenting with alternative ways of playing the sax. For this project, they explore the world of electronics and effects to create new sounds. Ntjam’s role is divers. She is the quartet’s fifth instrument, recites spoken word, plays (vocal) percussion, forms duos or trios with the saxophones and accompanies the quartet on her guitar. She performs texts in English as well as in French, one of Cameroon’s official languages, and sings in Bulu, her mother tongue.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans, Smooth
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album Swiss Movement which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today’s broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann’s vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including Just Like Magic, backed by his wonderful Magic Band of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Tim Kliphuis and the NCO: The Changing Seasons, Fusion
programme.desc: The Netherlands Chamber Orchestra commissioned violinist Tim Kliphuis, internationally known for his genre-crossing approach to music, to write a new version of Antonio Vivaldi's ‘Four Seasons’. Kliphuis choose to take improvisation as his starting point; at the same time, he intended to leave the best-known Vivaldi themes and chords in, as they give the piece its wonderful energy. The result is a fresh and exciting interpretation that never loses sight of the original. Each season has a different character: the freshness of spring is reflected by the use of Irish and Norwegian traditional music; the summer heat can be heard in the American jazz and funk rhythms; the autumn includes a galloping safari hunt in South-Africa and the ice-cold winter warms up with the energy of Russian gypsy music. For each movement, Kliphuis has a metropole in mind which he visited on his previous concert tours. You’re about to witness a truly genre-crossing spectacle!

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling, Soul
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard Quintet in Brussels, 1980, Modern
programme.desc: By the time this set was recorded at Brussels Jazz Club in the summer of 1980, trumpeter Freddie Hubbard had already built an impressive resume. During the 1960s he became a leading voice in the hard bop movement while not shying away from avant-garde sessions with the likes of John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy. In the 1970s, Hubbard expanded his palette by recording in more diverse settings that included electric instruments and orchestral arrangements. On this club date, Hubbard showcases all of the experience he had accumulated up to this point. The working group consists includes David Schnitter on tenor saxophone, Billy Childs on keyboards, Larry Klein on bass, and Sinclair Lott on drums. Watch as the quintet deftly switches between acoustic and electric instruments and Hubbard entertains the crowd with his onstage antics.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball with The NPG and Questlove, Urban
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.tv have been collaborating for a series of music programmes: ‘BIRD.tv’, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from the first row! This episode is a fantastic registration of the after party of the North Sea Jazz Festival: Boogieball. This mega jam session is a great coming together of, amongst others, Anthony Hamilton, Anderson Paak, Christian Scott, Cory Henry and Kneebody!

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne 2017, Jazz
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Kinda Dukish & Rockin' in Rhythm, Concert
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. Among the many talents in the Orchestra were trumpeter Clark Terry, trombonist Quentin Jackson, saxophonist Johnny Hodges and violinist Ray Nance.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Here's that rainy day, Concert
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating Nica's Dream in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of Here's That Rainy Day, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's You Stepped Out of a Dream and You Turned The Tables on Me, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform Extensions in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of I'm Getting Sentimental Over You from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock’s avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of Memphis Underground from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Song for my father, Concert
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver’s quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: Adjustment, Barbara, In Pursuit of the 27th Man, and Song For My Father. Tune in and let Horace Silver’s irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris, Blues
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar). From the first to the very last minute of the concert, Hooker illustrates why he, 45 years later, was to be ranked 35th on Rolling Stone’s 2015 list of 100 Greatest Guitarists: this bluesman is truly in a class of his own.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Vein ft. Greg Osby, Modern
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox. From young, local talents to top national and international artists, PARADOX Tilburg is the most intimate jazz club in the Netherlands, with a devoted audience from all across Europe. In their TV show PARADOX LIVE you get a taste of the greatest concerts and interviews with artists from all around the world. This episode of PARADOX LIVE presents the Swiss jazz band VEIN accompanied by saxophone player Greg Osby.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues, Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George Harmonica Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Misc: Jérôme Beaulieu live in Montreal, Modern
programme.desc: Modern jazz with a twist, based on a group effort rather than on personal virtuosity: meet ‘Misc’! Composer and pianist Jérôme Beaulieu, double bassist Philippe Leduc and drummer William Côté met during their college years at the Université de Montréal. Their ‘Trio Jérôme Beaulieu’ quickly made a name for itself, winning the Montreal contest ‘Jazz en Rafale’ and the ‘Grand Prix du Festi-Jazz’ in Rimouski within the same year. Since their 2012 debut album ‘L'Homme sur la lune’ was nominated for the Opus Prize for Jazz Album of the Year, the trio has been praised for its musical experiments and its contemporary jazz repertoire. The trio’s music boasts wide-ranging musical influences: from acoustic music enhanced with electronic rhythms and textures, to a palette of diverse textures accented with samples, eccentric percussion, effects and prepared instruments. With unabated musical enthusiasm yet under the new name ‘Misc’, the trio launched its self-titled third album in 2016.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto Band Live at Estival Lugano 1985, Latin
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Girl From Ipanema, Astrud Gilberto’s second name. The Brazilian bossa-nova and samba singer gives an outstanding, swinging performance at Estival Lugano. The band features Marcello Gilberto, David Sacks, Gil Goldstein, and Eduardo da Fonseca. Astrud started to record her own compositions in the '70s. She has recorded songs in Portuguese, English, Spanish, Italian, French, German, and Japanese.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets & Rosenwinkel, Fusion
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, Toots Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey. Although Beets’ parents originally did not associate the word musician with the word career, music is definitely in the family’s blood. At this concert at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen, the Netherlands, Peter Beets teams up with the world-famous guitarist Kurt Rosenwinkel. With a career spanning almost twenty-five years and including collaborating with dynamic peers like Brad Mehldau, Brian Blade, Mark Turner, Joshua Redman, Chris Potter, as well as esteemed jazz legends like Joe Henderson, Paul Motian and Gary Burton, Rosenwinkel’s indelible mark in music is the consummation of being steeped in the rich and deep traditions of jazz, springing off of the shoulders of such vital underpinnings to elevate his own art to new heights, evolving the language in a way no other guitarist has since his arrival. This collaboration between Beets and Rosenwinkel guarantees brilliant music.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Antonio Faraò 4tet, Modern
programme.desc: Antonio Faraò features prominently in the rich group of talented Italian pianists. He is the winner of the 1998 prestigious Concours Martial Solal, awarded by Herbie Hancock, and he has made his mark as a player of elegance and lyricism. This has allowed him to collaborate with the best European and American musicians. In his album ‘Evan’, recorded in the USA, he leads an all-star band, notably starring Joe Lovano on tenor. In this particular recording at Jazz à Ramatuelle, he appears at the Theatre de Verdure in the company of another sax legend - Dave Liebman, a musician of unfailing generosity and himself the repository of more than 40 years of modern jazz history. With refined ballads and feline groove, this meeting sparkles, perhaps even lighting up some new stars in the night above Ramatuelle.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés', Modern
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911-1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland. With a local rhythm section of French pianist Henry Chaix, Swiss double bassist Théo Siegrist, and Swiss drummer Pierre Bouru, this stalwart of the Count Basie Orchestra gave a sparkling performance that was documented for posterity by Radio Télévision Suisse in the program ‘Variétés’. Opening with the George Gershwin favorite ‘’S Wonderful’, the program continues with two swing-era classics: ‘I Can't Get Started’ and ‘Honeysuckle Rose’. Revel at how easily Clayton finishes ‘Honeysuckle Rose’ on a high concert F! A spirited romp through Juan Tizol’s composition ‘Perdido’ closes this recording. The success of this booking ensured Clayton received repeated warm receptions in Bern in the following decades.

programme.title: B.B. King Orchestra - The North Sea Jazz, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1979, legendary American blues guitarist B.B. King gave an unforgettable performance for the audience in The Hague. Born in 1925 in a small town in Mississippi, 'Lucille' (as he nicknamed his guitar) helped him escape a miserable existence picking cotton. He arrived in Memphis in the late 1940s, where his cousin Bukka White taught him the tricks of the blues. Soon he developed his own style. King’s virtuoso, narrative solos with lots of vibrato, have been an inspiration for most (rock) guitarists after him.

programme.title: Wee Dot, Concert
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In October 1968, two former colleagues met again on stage, this time leading their own bands at the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam: drummer Art Blakey and pianist Horace Silver were both co-founders of The Jazz Messengers.

programme.title: Ellington Medley, Concert
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. Among the many talents in the Orchestra were trumpeter Clark Terry, trombonist Quentin Jackson, saxophonist Johnny Hodges and violinist Ray Nance.

programme.title: Hackensack, Concert
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs Autumn Leaves, Hackensack, My Favorite Things, I Want To Talk About You, Vigil, and Naima. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam, Urban
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.tv have been collaborating for a series of music programs: BIRD.tv, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from a first-row seat! Discover an irresistible live act; STUFF is full of unflagging energy. The Belgian band was founded in 2012 when drummer Lander Gyselinck was asked to play live music between DJ sets at a local bar. He gathered a bunch of friends, who also were musicians. The band could be considered an avant-garde jazz band who play a mix of funk, hip-hop, and electro. Andrew Claes (saxophone), Dries Laheye (bass guitar), Lander Gyselinck (drums), Mixmonster Menno (samples), and Joris Caluwaerts (keyboards) share an exceptional connection in music. They take over every stage and melt the hearts of music lovers.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone, Concert
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone. After that, she continued her career with the release of ‘Nome de Mar’, which received many positive reviews. At the moment, Maria Ana is performing at all Portugal’s major venues, as well as many festivals and concert halls throughout the world, with the aim to present fado music and Portuguese culture to other cultures. Bobone’s latest album, ‘Fado & Piano’, shows her diversity as an artist, composer and arranger. By including the piano she re-innovates the tradition of the early 20th century. This portrait shows Maria Ana’s performances and interviews in which she explains her passion for fado music and culture.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich, Modern
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians. Live from 'Jazzclub Unterfahrt' in Munich, Germany, together with Antti Lotjonen on bass and Teppo Makynen on drums, Rissanen showcases the best of Scandinavian jazz and its DNA - the Nordic Tone.

programme.title: 26. Gitar art festival - Branko Bako Jovanović
Arhiv. doc: Naša arhiva, vaš prozor u svet
programme.desc: Svetski dan audio-vizuelne baštine obeležava se svake godine 27. oktobra. Ovaj datum proglasio je UNESKO 2005. godine kako bi se podigla svest o značaju i rizicima očuvanja snimljenih zvučnih i video-zapisa. Toga dana, nacionalne filmske arhive, televizijske i radio-stanice, udruženja i brojne filmske institucije širom sveta organizuju javne programe, diskusije i predavanja sa ciljem da naglase značaj, osetljivost i ugroženost audio-vizuelnog nasleđa.

programme.title: Kamera je prisutna: Baršunasti bogatstveni put
programme.desc: Treća epizoda umetničko-dokumentarnog serijala Kamera je prisutna jeste nesvakidašnji pogled na konceptualnog umetnika i pisca Božidara Boška Mandića. Mandić, čovek dvadesetog veka, doživeo je svoju punu umetničku afirmaciju u dvadeset prvom veku. Njegove ideje su danas aktuelnije nego ikad, ekstremni ekološki aktivizam je njegova glavna tema još od vremena kada se i dalje pušilo u avionima i bolnicama. O doslednosti divljizmu i verovanju u plemenitost neznanja, Boško je govorio u nebrojenim radio i TV emisijama, knjigama i u umetničkoj novinskoj prozi za Politiku i Danas.Ovoga puta, u TV dokumentarnom filmu Bogatstveni baršunasti put, trećoj epizodi serijala Kamera je prisutna videćemo Boška u drugoj dimenziji, u prostoru u kome je on tokom svog života duboko sveprisutan, ali o kome do sada nikada javno nije govorio. To je njegov intimni svet auto-stopa, njegov odnos sa vozačima koji su ga vozili na njegovoj standardnoj ruti Beograd-Rudnik i nazad. Kamerom je kormilario i ovoga puta direktor fotografije David Pavlašević, puzle u montaži umetnički spajao Stevan Lung, a sve to zajedno vozio reditelj i scenarista bez vozačke dozvole Gregor Zupanc.Urednik serijala Olivera Pančić.

programme.title: Volim klasiku, 45. emisija
programme.desc: U 45. izdanju serijala Volim klasiku, povodom predstojećeg velikog jubileja - devedeset godina Fakulteta muzičke umetnosti u Beogradu, nastupiće studenti i profesori različitih odseka naše najstarije muzičke visokoškolske ustanove.

programme.title: Serija sa audiodeskripcijom: Nobelovac, Telegram, serija
programme.desc: Državni vrh Jugoslavije doživljava Nobelovu nagradu kao priznanje zemlji za neblokovsku i nesvrstanu politiku koju vodi. Dobrica Ćosić požuruje Tita da pošalje Andriću telegram kojim će mu čestitati. Na konferenciji za novinare, Andrić odgovara na pitanja o Bosni i detinjstvu, čime priziva sećanje na boravak u Sarajevu 1945, odlazak na majčin grob, skupštinu ZAVNOBIH-a i susrete sa Elijem Fincijem i školskim drugom Borom Jevtićem.

programme.title: Do detalja
programme.desc: Enes Halilović je objavio knjige pesama: „Srednje slovo", „Bludni parip", „Listovi na vodi", „Pesme iz bolesti i zdravlja", „Zidovi", „Bangladeš i Sekvoja". Autor je triju zbirki priča, triju drama i romana: „Ep o vodi", „Ako dugo gledaš u ponor", „LJudi bez grobova i Bekos".

programme.title: Život u okupiranom Beogradu 1941-1944: Godina poslednja 7-7
programme.desc: U poslednjoj epizodi dokumentarne serije Život u okupiranom Beogradu 1941-1944, sagovornici, istoričari i svedoci govore o poslednjoj godini okupacije i pripremama kolaboracionog aparata za bežanje i skrivanje pred jedinicama NOVJ i Sovjetske armije koje su nadirale ka Beogradu. Takođe, biće reči o licima iz sfere javnog života, intelektualcima, profesorima, umetnicima i drugima, koji su ušli u otvorenu kolaboraciju sa okupatorom i o njihovoj sudbini posle oslobođenja.

programme.title: Tamburica fest 2018: Zvonko Bogdan
programme.desc: Svetski tamburaški festival „Tamburica fest", održava se na Petrovaradinskoj tvrđavi u Novom Sadu i u centu grada, kao trodnevna manifestacija sa jedinstvenom koncepcijom i kulturnom misijom afirmisanja tamburaške muzike i tamburice kao instrumenta, ali i kao negovanje tradicije, saradnje i prijateljstva umetnika na internacionalnom nivou.

programme.title: Đorđe Marjanović: Milord, serija
programme.desc: Idol mnogih generacija, Đorđe Marjanović, veliki Milord, učitelj brojnih estradnih ličnosti, umetnik koji je ostavio neizbrisiv trag u razvoju domaće muzičke scene. I u doba najveće slave, kada je punio dvorane i stadione širom SFRJ i SSSR-a, većina ga je obožavala; bilo je i onih koji su ga kudili, ali su svi bez razlike jednostavno morali da mu odaju priznanje za trud, želju, ljubav i umeće koje je darovao publici.

programme.title: Mama i tata se igraju rata, serija
programme.desc: Glavni akteri ove humoristične serije su supružnici Veljko (Gordan Kičić) i Jadranka (Nina Janković), čiji brak nakon nekoliko godina ulazi u ozbiljnu krizu. Veljko je glumac koji još uvijek čeka svoju veliku ulogu, a Jadranka je arhitektica koja nosi gotovo svu odgovornost njihovog zajedničkog života na svojim leđima. Njihova drama nastaje kada Jadranka priopći Veljku da se želi razvesti od njega.

Zagorci, Međimurci, Podravci, ali i ostali kojima je KAJ u duši u svakoj će od emisija pronaći nešto za sebe - glazba poznatih pjevača i sastava kajkavskog kraja, zanimljive priče i legende, ali i posebnosti koje svojim sadržajem odražavaju duhovitost, vrijednost tradicije te bogatu i znimljivu povijest i puno dobre zabave.

programme.title: ČOVJEK I BOG, dokumentarna emisija
programme.desc: Njemačka emisija o religiji Čovjek i Bog u 30 minuta trajanja bavi se propitivanjem odnosa Boga i čovjeka, u razgovornoj dokumentarističkoj formi jedan na jedan.

programme.title: VTV TJEDNIK, informativna emisija
programme.desc: donosi pregled najvažnijih događaja u Gradu Varaždinu, Varaždinskoj i Međimurskoj županiji koji su obilježili protekli tjedan. Sve te događaje prikazujemo ponovno, ovoga puta u novom svjetlu, promatrajući ih s vremenske distance, uz najnovije informacije i komentare. Pregled je realiziran tako da se po danima (od ponedjeljka do subote) ponove opširne vijesti koje su obilježile pojedine dane. Emisiju «VTV tjednik» realiziramo s komentarom za slušno oštećene osobe, čime smo uspjeli, na veliko zadovoljstvo, približiti naš informativni program i toj skupini naših gledatelja.

programme.title: PUTOPISI, dokumentarna emisija
programme.desc: Jurica Galić Juka profesionalni je fotograf, svjetski putnik, putopisac, stalni suradnik časopisa Meridijani i snimatelj dokumentarnih filmova iz Splita. Do 2022. godine obišao je više od 70 država na 5 kontinenata, piše putopise i izrađuje video dokumentarce. U fotografiji je dobitnik dvadesetak nacionalnih i svjetskih nagrada, a izlagao je samostalno trinaest puta.

Ljubomora, serija
programme.desc: Dok Seniha polaže dugo odgađani ispit uprkos Halitovim pokušajima da je zaustavi, Mukerem i Nalan ulaze u žestok sukob zbog Nuzheta i zajedničkog posla. Nakon ispita policija privodi Senihu po Halitovoj prijavi, ali ona odlučuje da će mu oduzeti ugled i sve što joj je godinama uskraćivao. Profesor Selim otkriva Nuzhetu koliko je Halit nemilosrdan i odlučuju mu se zajedno osvetiti. Seniha pokreće plan osvete u kojem važnu ulogu imaju Turkan i Mukeremina porodična kuća. Nuzhet odbija napustiti Senihu, dok Nalan postaje sve sumnjičavija prema njihovoj bliskosti.

programme.title: Ljubomora, serija
programme.desc: Halit saznaje da je Mukerem zbog majčinih dugova potpisivala dokumente u kockarnici, nakon čega odlučuje da se razvede od nje. Burak otkriva da je Mukeremina porodična kuća sada njegovo vlasništvo i u nju useljava Turkan. Mukerem uzalud pokušava spasiti svoj brak i vratiti izgubljeni dom, dok ju Halit odlučno kažnjava svojim odsustvom. Bivši porodični kućepazitelj Halitu otkriva da zna istinu o smrti njegovog oca. Seniha uz pomoć profesora Selima počinje pripremati plan kojim želi zadati Halitu težak profesionalni udarac.

programme.title: Za istim stolom
programme.desc: Jedinstveni recepti najboljih kuhara koji nam omogućavaju da manje vremena provedemo u kuhinji, a više u razgovoru za stolom. Za stolom ne dijelimo samo hranu, dijelimo vrijeme, pažnju, ljubav i za istim stolom postajemo bolji. U emisiji 'Za istim stolom' razgovaramo o nečemu što svi poznajemo, ali rijetko o tome duboko razmišljamo - o filozofiji okupljanja za stolom. Da li je ručak samo obrok ili mnogo više? Cilj ove emisije je da ugostimo plemenite goste, podijelimo s njima stil života kao važne lekcije, razgovaramo o vrijednostima života, ali i kvaliteti obroka. Naša opredjeljenost je uvijek za najbolje i to dijelimo i sa gledateljima. Pred nama je sezona izdvojenih tema, posebnih recepata, specijalnih gostiju kroz koju nas vodi Maja Munda.

programme.title: Okusi ljeta s Majom
programme.desc: Emisija OKUSI LJETA S MAJOM je vedra i inspirativna kulinarsko-putopisna emisija koja slavi jednostavne ljetne okuse, domaće namirnice, ali i radost zajedničkog kuhanja. U svakoj epizodi, od ponedjeljka do četvrtka voditeljica Maja Munda priprema brze, ukusne i lako primjenjive recepte prilagođene užurbanom svakodnevnom životu, pokazujući kako od sezonskih sastojaka napraviti obroke pune okusa. Maja u odabranim epizodama odlazi u posjetu domaćinstvima širom zemlje, gdje upoznaje vrijedne domaćine koji uzgajaju vlastito voće, povrće i začinsko bilje u svojim baštama. Zajedno s njima bere svježe plodove, otkriva zanimljive porodične priče i tradicionalne recepte te priprema jela koja spajaju domaću tradiciju i moderne kulinarske ideje. „Okusi ljeta s Majom donose autentične priče, korisne kuharske savjete i pregršt inspiracije za sve ljubitelje dobre hrane, pokazujući da najbolji obroci nastaju od svježih sastojaka, jednostavnih recepata i druženja za zajedničkim stolom. Svaka epizoda poziva gledaoce da otkriju bogatstvo ljetnih okusa i novih brzih, praktičnih recepata koji mogu biti inspiracija za zdrave obroke ovoga ljeta.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Eren javlja Halilu da je fotografska radnja obijena prethodne noći i da je sve uništeno. Halil sada ne za kako da utvrdi Zejnepinu nevinost. Ipak, Eren spašava situaciju i dolazi do fotografija. Halil zaključuje da je tog sudbonosnog dana Zejnep možda bila u bolnici i da nije mogla otjerati njegovu majku s kapije imanja. Hakan se i dalje bori za Ferihu, ali ima moćnog protivnika - nanu Fatmu. Tulaj očekuje Fejaza na doručku, ali on ne dolazi jer nema hrabrosti da se suoči sa Selmom. Umjesto toga, on poziva Tulaj da se nađu nasamo i osmisle plan. Alper i Halil se sve više sukobljavaju zbog Zejnep.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Zejnep je umorna od toga što je drugi povezuju a Halilom, ali također nije sigurna šta osjeća. Alper daje Zejnep poklon, ali ona ga odbija i traži distancu. Hakan pravi Fatmi smicalicu u kafiću. Dječak Ali zove Halila, i on i Zejnep mu prave zmaja za njegovu školsku drugaricu koju je povrijedio. Dok rade, razgovaraju o mogućnosti praštanja. Eren prikuplja informacije da se vidi kada je Zejnep boravila u bolnici kao dijete. Kada Halil vidi dokumente, shvata da je Zejnep nevina za bol njegove majke, i spopada ga veliki bijes prema samome sebi.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Zejnep je umorna od toga što je drugi povezuju a Halilom, ali također nije sigurna šta osjeća. Alper daje Zejnep poklon, ali ona ga odbija i traži distancu. Hakan pravi Fatmi smicalicu u kafiću. Dječak Ali zove Halila, i on i Zejnep mu prave zmaja za njegovu školsku drugaricu koju je povrijedio. Dok rade, razgovaraju o mogućnosti praštanja. programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Halila razara kajanje što je toliko boli nanio Zejnep, a sada zna da je ona nevina. Ipak, nema hrabrosti da joj kaže istinu. On zove majstora Aziza da ga posavjetuje šta da radi. Selma poštom dobija voljenu lutku iz djetinjstva, ali ne zna od koga je. Alper ne odustaje od udvaranja Zejnep, sve kako bi nanio bol Halilu. Također je moli da s njim pogleda još jednu parcelu koju navodno želi kupiti. Zejnep primjećuje da se s Halilom nešto događa, ali ne može da prodre do njega.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Halil obećava da će se osvetiti pravim krivcima za patnju njegove porodice. Feriha saznaje da neće dobiti vizu da ide kod Guldže, što je Hakanu drago. Zejnep i Alper odlaze do zemlje koju Alper navodno želi kupiti. Tu on pravi spletku Zejnep, koja upada u vrlo tešku situaciju, ali ubrzo dolazi Halil. Dok pokušava da je spasi, govori joj koliko mu ona znači. Saznajemo da Fejaz stoji iza poklona za Selmu. On dolazi na imanje i zatiče Selmu u bašti sa Zumrut.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Halil se bori da spasi Zejnep koju je Alper otrovao i koja je propala u podrum kuće koja se ruši. Dok to radi, priča joj priču svog života i obećava joj da će sve između njih biti drugačije. Na kraju je vozi u bolnicu, ali njeno stanje je loše. Fejaz moli Selmu da mu da još jednu šansu, ali ona ga odlučno odbija. Hakan tješi Ferihu što nije dobila vizu i vodi je na posebno mjesto pored mora. Fatma razmišlja da zovne momka iz sela kome želi dati Ferihu.

programme.title: Pravo vrijeme
programme.desc: Pravo vrijeme - emisija koja donosi iskrene razgovore, dobre vibracije i ljude koji stvaraju muziku, glumce, producente, sportiste i mnoge druge iz kulture i show biznisa. Svake sedmice u studiju su lica koja ostavljaju trag - govore otvoreno o svom putu, inspiraciji i svakodnevici iza reflektora. Tu su i ekskluzivni nastupi, premijere, spontani momenti i priče koje se rijetko čuju.

programme.title: Vijesti u 7
programme.desc: U Vijestima u 7, Hayat TV-a našoj centralnoj informativnoj emisiji, informišemo javnost o najznačajnijim događajima iz zemlje, regije i svijeta. Svakodnevno pravimo naše priče po kojima smo postali prepoznatljiv brend i prvi izbor gledalaca dugi niz godina. Naš izbor je istina, neka vaš budu Vijesti u 7.

programme.title: Ispuni mi želju
programme.desc: Emisija Ispuni mi želju, koja usrećuje porodice, djecu, stare i mlade program je za sve generacije. Otvaranje puteva sreće, ličnog zadovoljstva jer smo nekoga učinili sretnim barem na trenutak, osjećaj je koji se ne može mijenjati nijednim drugim. Spoznaja da smo svi zajedno bili dio promjene, otvorili jedan novi prozor u nedodirljivo je apsolutna sloboda, a načini na koji usrećujemo druge su bezbrojni, neograničeni i snažno u konačnici umirujući. Društveno odgovorna osoba, koja predvodi društveno odgovorno poslovanje i čini život ugodnijim ljudima oko sebe sigurno je kvalitetan proizvod zajednice koja ga okružuje. Biti uvijek na strani one ruke koja nas treba je jednostavnost života kojoj svi težimo, a upravo ta savršena jednostvanost čovjeka ispunjava do beskraja, i još dalje. Imati priliku biti na putu dobra, i mogućnosti da se promovirate kroz nemjerljive trenutke radosti jednog života privilegija je onih koji će uvijek i u svemu vidjeti, a na kraju i osjetiti samo uspjeh i zadovoljstvo, kako poslovno tako i lično.

programme.title: Slučajevi X
programme.desc: Emisija Slučajevi X, koja se nedjeljom u 22 sata emitira u programu Hayat TV-a, jedna je od najgledanijih u BiH, a prepoznatljiva je i van granica naše domovine. Ova specijalistička emisija tretira tamnu stranu života u Bosni i Hercegovini i regionu. Tamo gdje policija ide s upaljenim rotacijama, Slučajevi X dolaze s kamerom. Slučajevi X su specifičan format TV-emisije i prvi kriminalistički magazin u našoj zemlji. Od prve emisije skreće veliku pažnju gledalaca gotovo svakom novom epizodom. I to traje već godinama, od 2007, što potvrđuje gledanost emisije, ali i milionski pregledi na Youtubeu. Primarni cilj emisije jeste da u mladima ne podstiče želju da idu stranputicom, odnosno putem kriminala, da shvate da kriminal nije model ponašanja koji je društveno prihvatljiv. Vremenom, zbog društvenog doprinosa, Slučajevi X su postali višestruko nagrađivana emisija. Gotovo da nema policijske agencije ili uprave u BiH koja, zbog navedenog, nije Slučajevima X javno dodijelila specijalna priznanja i zahvalnice.

programme.title: Miraculous: Pustolovine Bubamare i Crnog Mačka
programme.desc: Samo oni mogu spasiti Pariz od zlikovaca! Marinette Dupain-Cheng i Adrien Agreste naizgled su obični pariški srednjoškolci koji se ni po čemu ne razlikuju od svojih vršnjaka, no oboje kriju misterioznu tajnu - upravo su oni odabrani da svoj grad spase od zlikovaca. Zahvaljujući magičnom dragulju poznatom pod nazivom Miraculous, Marinette i Adrien transformiraju se u superjunake Bubamaru i Crnog Mačka te zajedno surađuju kako bi Pariz zaštitili od beskrupuloznog Hawka Motha koji na različite načine pokušava ukrasti Miraculous i oduzeti im moći, prijeteći kako će ih iskoristiti protiv njih te obične građane pretvoriti u negativce. No iako rade zajedno, ni Bubamara ni Crni Mačak ne znaju međusobne identitete. Mariette je potajno zaljubljena u Adriena, a on smatra kako je ona samo još jedna djevojka iz njegovog razreda. Miracolous: Pustolovine Bubamara i Crnog Mačka animirana je akcijska serija autora Jeremyja Zaga, nastala 2015. godine u produkciji francuskih studija Zagtoona i Method Animationa u suradnji s produkcijskim kućama De Agostini Editore u Italiji, Toei Animation u Japanu te SAMG Animation u Južnoj Koreji. Ideja o Bubamari i Crnom mačku nastala je na temelju američkih i francuskih stripova te japanske animacije, poput priče o Spider-Manu ili Mjesečevoj ratnici. Prva sezona krenula je s emitiranjem krajem 2015. godine, a ukupno je snimljeno 48 epizoda. O velikoj popularnosti serije svjedoči potvrđena treća sezona koja bi trebala biti premijerno prikazana 2019. godine te osvojena Teen Choice Awards nagrada za najbolju animiranu TV seriju iz 2018. godine.

Marinette Dupain-Cheng i Adrien Agreste naizgled su obični pariški srednjoškolci koji se ni po čemu ne razlikuju od svojih vršnjaka, no oboje kriju misterioznu tajnu - upravo su oni odabrani da svoj grad spase od zlikovaca. Zahvaljujući magičnom dragulju poznatom pod nazivom Miraculous, Marinette i Adrien transformiraju se u superjunake Bubamaru i Crnog Mačka te zajedno surađuju kako bi Pariz zaštitili od beskrupuloznog Hawka Motha koji na različite načine pokušava ukrasti Miraculous i oduzeti im moći, prijeteći kako će ih iskoristiti protiv njih te obične građane pretvoriti u negativce. No iako rade zajedno, ni Bubamara ni Crni Mačak ne znaju međusobne identitete. Mariette je potajno zaljubljena u Adriena, a on smatra kako je ona samo još jedna djevojka iz njegovog razreda. Miracolous: Pustolovine Bubamara i Crnog Mačka animirana je akcijska serija autora Jeremyja Zaga, nastala 2015. godine u produkciji francuskih studija Zagtoona i Method Animationa u suradnji s produkcijskim kućama De Agostini Editore u Italiji, Toei Animation u Japanu te SAMG Animation u Južnoj Koreji. Ideja o Bubamari i Crnom mačku nastala je na temelju američkih i francuskih stripova te japanske animacije, poput priče o Spider-Manu ili Mjesečevoj ratnici. Prva sezona krenula je s emitiranjem krajem 2015. godine, a ukupno je snimljeno 48 epizoda. O velikoj popularnosti serije svjedoči potvrđena treća sezona koja bi trebala biti premijerno prikazana 2019. godine te osvojena Teen Choice Awards nagrada za najbolju animiranu TV seriju iz 2018. godine.

Wilde Schweiz II: Die Jungfrau-Region
programme.desc: Švicarska - lijepa i puna divljih predjela, nevelika no raznovrsna. Poznata po planinskim lancima, rijekama, jezerima i šumama, ova zemlja u srcu Europe oduzima dah ljepotom krajolika. Ima gotovo 1500 jezera, 80 planina viših od 4000 metara, 150 ledenjaka i šume koje prekrivaju gotovo trećinu površine. Tu još postoje područja netaknute prirode: blagi brežuljci, kamenite litice, tajanstvene vrištine i moćni slapovi. Sve su to važna staništa plahih divokoza, mirisnih alpskih ruža, divlje pastrve i rijetkih orhideja. Vrijeme je da ta područja otkrijemo, istražimo i divimo im se. Krećemo u ekspediciju zaštićenim prirodnim područjima predstavljajući bogatstvo biljnog i životinjskog svijeta te mitove i legende pojedinih švicarskih regija. Brodarska tvrtka na najvećoj nadmorskoj visini u Europi, najbrojnija populacija kozoroga u Švicarskoj, najstariji švicarski borovi... Došli smo u kanton Graubünden. Krajolik oko jezera u Engadinu može se opisivati samo u superlativima. Četiri impresivna jezera okružena su planinama visokima između 3000 i 4000 metara u kojima ćete naći najljepšu alpsku floru i faunu - sirištaru, runolist, kozoroga, svisca i stoljetne švicarske borove.

programme.desc: Sprema se maturalni ples u bogataškoj školi, ali netom prije polaska Tessa Nobile (Sarah Steele) dobije poruku od svog pratitelja Joea koji je ostavlja na cjedilu zato što njezin prijatelj Paul (Peter Oliver) kaže da ona "igra za suprotnu ekipu." Tessa razgovara sa suigračicom s lacrossea Kianaom (Sonequa Martin) koja joj kaže da se ne zabrinjava. Sutradan Paula u parku napadne skupina maskiranih djevojaka. Paul iz osvete cijeloj školi pošalje zlobni lažirani video u kojem su Kiana i Tessa prikazane zajedno u krevetu. Tessa istrči sa sata svoje majke Anne (Joanna Adler), a kad Anna ode potražiti kćer, nađe Paula kako visi s cijevi u kotlovnici. Paulov otac je direktor moćne korporacije i traži od Gorena (Vincent D'Onofrio) i Eamesice (Kathryn Erbe) iz Odjela za teške zločine da istraže smrt njegovog sina.
